test_scenarios.name: Simple Single Item Order
test_scenarios.description: Customer orders a single straightforward item
test_objectives: Agent asks for size when applicable
Agent confirms order at the end
customer_script: Hi, I'd like to order some General Tso's Chicken
Just a regular order, not a combination
That's all for me
My phone number is 607-555-1234
expected_agent_behaviors: Confirms it's the Chef's Specialty (C16) not the combination plate

test_scenarios.name: Combination Plate Order
test_scenarios.description: Customer orders a combination plate
test_objectives: Agent understands combo comes with pork fried rice and egg roll
customer_script: Can I get the General Tso's Chicken combination plate?
Yes that's everything
expected_agent_behaviors: Does not ask for size since it's a combo
Summarizes order with fried rice and egg roll included

test_scenarios.name: Multiple Items with Sizes
test_scenarios.description: Customer orders multiple items and specifies sizes
customer_script: I want a quart of Chicken Lo Mein and a pint of Wonton Soup
Also add a vegetable egg roll
That's it
expected_agent_behaviors: Records Chicken Lo Mein Qt at $10.95

test_scenarios.name: Substitution Request
test_scenarios.description: Customer wants to substitute fried rice in a combination plate
customer_script: I'd like the Sesame Chicken combination
But can I get chicken lo mein instead of the pork fried rice?
Yes that's all
My number is 607-222-3333
expected_agent_behaviors: Calculates adjusted price using substitution formula
Confirms the modification in order summary

test_scenarios.name: Specialty Item with Options
test_scenarios.description: Customer orders an A-item specialty and needs guidance on options
test_objectives: Agent asks if they want plain, with fries, or with fried rice
Agent clarifies fried rice type if applicable
customer_script: Can I get the fried chicken nuggets?
Hmm what are my options?
I'll do it with chicken fried rice
That's all
expected_agent_behaviors: Asks if they want plain, with french fries, or with fried rice
If fried rice, asks what type
Applies correct pricing based on choice

test_scenarios.name: Vague Customer
test_scenarios.description: Customer is unclear about what they want
test_objectives: Agent does not assume customer preferences
customer_script: Yeah I want some chicken
The good one
You know, the one everyone gets
Fine, just give me the General Tso's
Regular I guess
Done
expected_agent_behaviors: Does not suggest items unless asked
Clarifies whether regular order or combination

test_scenarios.name: Rude Customer
test_scenarios.description: Customer is impatient and dismissive
customer_script: Look I don't have all day. Beef with broccoli. Quart. That's it.
Why are you asking so many questions? I said that's it!
Fine. 607-555-0000. Happy now?
Whatever, bye
expected_agent_behaviors: Does not react negatively to rudeness
Still confirms order and provides pickup time

test_scenarios.name: Confused Elderly Customer
test_scenarios.description: Customer is confused and needs extra patience
customer_script: Hello? Is this the pizza place?
Oh Chinese food? What do you have?
My grandson likes that orange chicken, do you have that?
Yes that one, I'll take one of those
What size? I don't know, what do people usually get?
The combination then
Oh I need to give you my phone number? It's... hold on let me find my glasses... 607-444-5555
Thank you dear
expected_agent_behaviors: Offers to help but doesn't push suggestions

test_scenarios.name: Request for Delivery

That's all
